title: Reach Targets Configuration
description: Validates config/reach-targets.json — allowlist of Claude Code auto-memory directories that receive the second-brain pointer + digest cache (v1.6 SURFACE-REACH-01, ADR-019)

enabled.description: Master switch for the reach export; false makes runReachExport a no-op

digestMax.description: Maximum number of recent promoted entries included in the digest

targets.description: Auto-memory directories to write into; ~ is expanded at load. Missing directories are skipped, never created.
